query: State of EV car sales in the US in 2026

docs.title: US EV sales report 2026
docs.text: US electric vehicle sales fell 28% in 2026 as demand cooled, according to Cox Automotive. EV car buyers in the US grew more cautious about pricing during the 2026 sales season.

docs.title: EV registrations slid in 2026
docs.text: EV car registrations in the US dropped 19% during 2026 across most states nationwide. Analysts said the US electric vehicle market cooled after several years of rapid growth.
